capabilities: Browse Zotero annotations in a sidebar
Quote annotations into notes with links back to the PDF
extras: README is minimal; the feature list comes from the manifest description. Requires Zotero's Local API turned on (127.0.0.1:23119); all communication stays local and nothing is sent to the internet. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is also available in Traditional Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull annotations and notes from a Zotero library or link quotes back to their source PDFs.

relations.evidence: A plugin connecting Zotero and Obsidian.

requires.name: Zotero 10 with the Local API enabled

summary: Zotero integration that browses Zotero annotations in a sidebar, quotes them into notes with links back to the PDF, and edits Zotero notes.
